content:
The Apple store at The Oracle shopping centre in Reading, UK, is moving to a new location in December and reopening with a fresh design.

Before that, the Apple store at Festival Place in Basingstoke will close in November, bringing the total number of Apple retail stores in the UK down to 38...

Apple says the redesigned Oracle store will offer everything customers expect from its latest store design.

We're excited to reopen the completely redesigned Apple The Oracle this December, offering customers in the South East of England a new way to discover and shop the latest Apple products and get support for their devices. The new Apple The Oracle will feature an Experience Room where customers can explore the products; a dedicated Genius Bar and Apple Pick Up area for collecting online orders; and free Today at Apple sessions to help customers get even more from the products they love.

The store first opened in June 2011. Before the reopening, Apple's Basingstoke store will close first.

While preparing for these updates, we've decided to close the Apple Festival Place store. Apple Festival Place will remain open until November 2026, after which all team members will have the opportunity to move to roles at Apple The Oracle or other Apple Store locations. For the past 15 years, it's been a privilege to serve the Basingstoke community, and we look forward to continuing to welcome customers at nearby Apple Stores, as well as through Apple.com, the Apple Store app, and Apple Authorised Resellers and service providers across the South East of England.

That store has also been operating since 2011.

In the past 18 months, Apple has refurbished its stores on Regent Street in London and at Lakeside shopping centre in Essex. Stores in Birmingham and Southampton are also being upgraded.

Globally, Apple has opened 11 new stores in the past 18 months and relocated another 17 to new sites with fresh designs, including Apple Miami Worldcenter and Apple Downtown Detroit.
